payload.summary: Refined fail-closed review routing and convergence checkpoint quorum handling. SDK reviews now reject unsupported thinking before execution, while checkpoint quorum preserves and evaluates logical attempt-chain evidence.
completed_work: Rejected unsupported SDK thinking before any SDK invocation and retained a configuration attempt artifact.
Applied shared logical-result quorum eligibility during convergence checkpointing and quorum checks.
Added regressions for SDK thinking rejection and malformed-chain quorum exclusion.
Passed 145 targeted tests, 50 coordinator routing tests, focused Ruff, schema parity, and strict OpenSpec validation.

decisions.title: Reject unsupported SDK thinking before dispatch
decisions.rationale: A successful SDK response must not silently omit a requested reviewer thinking setting.

decisions.title: Use attempt-chain eligibility for recovery-aware convergence
decisions.rationale: A legacy success flag cannot override malformed or ineligible logical review evidence.
